data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for video compression and thumbnail generation using native APIs.
data.what_it_does: V Video Compressor compresses video files using native platform APIs (Media3 on Android and AVFoundation on iOS) without relying on FFmpeg. It provides real-time progress tracking, batch processing, thumbnail generation, cancellation support, and advanced configuration parameters like resolution, bitrate, cropping, and trimming.
use_when: You need to compress videos on Android and iOS before uploading or storing them.
You want native performance and hardware acceleration without bloating app size with FFmpeg.
You need real-time progress tracking or global progress streams during compression.
avoid_when: You need to play media back within the app instead of compressing it.
You need web or desktop support, as this package is limited to Android and iOS.
strengths: Uses native APIs (Media3 and AVFoundation) for optimal performance and smaller binary size.
Provides a strongly typed global progress stream for tracking operations anywhere in the app.
Offers rich advanced configuration options including custom cropping, trimming, codecs, and batch processing.
weaknesses: Limited platform support restricted only to Android and iOS.
Requires native permission configurations for storage and photo libraries.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding storage and photo library permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and targets minimum API 21 for Android and iOS 15 (SwiftPM) or iOS 12 (CocoaPods).
